summary: Trivial __stdcall wrapper that unpacks three low bytes from a packed dword a2 and forwards them, together with a1, to RGBColorSpaceCompactionTo16Bit. Used from the 2D surface blit/fill path. Decomposes a2 into BYTE2, BYTE1 and BYTE0 and returns the compaction result.

operations.description: Extract byte components of a2: BYTE2(a2), BYTE1(a2) and (unsigned __int8)a2.
Return the value produced by RGBColorSpaceCompactionTo16Bit.

unresolved: Meaning of the four packed bytes in a2 (alpha/red/green/blue ordering) is not established from this packet.
Role of a1 (color handle, format, or packed value) is caller-dependent and unknown here.
